description: Carrie Isaac, a strong contender, is one of several vying for the house seat. Comal and Hays Counties would be fortunate to be represented by a female who is pro-family, pro-life and pro-2A. She is the mother of two teenage boys, 17 and 19 years of age and is married to Jason Isaac for over 21 years
paid_for_by: paid for by Carrie Isaac for Texas
title: Bulverde Standard: Carrie Isaac Seeks District 73 Rep. Seat — Carrie Isaac for Texas
